answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 853 Country: DE Title: Once, I entered a mosque during fajr, I saw a person with very small beard (less then one mushth) doing imaamat. I joined the jumaat. Was this a correct act? If not, what else should I have done? Question: My question is: Once, I entered a mosque during fajr, I saw a person with very small beard (less then one mushth) doing imaamat. I joined the jumaat. Was this a correct act? If not, what else should I have done? Answer ID: 853 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 372=363/M) In the above condition, you got the virtue and reward of Jamat provided there was no other thing in Salah that might nullify it: و فی الدر: صلی خلف فاسق او مبتدع نال فضل الجماعة If you joined Salah accidentally or unknowingly then there is no problem whatsoever. However, the imamah (leading prayer) of a person who has beard less than one fist is makrooh (unliked). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
